name: Sarah Solberg
headline: Senior Director of Professional Services Global Operations at Tenable
about: Versatile professional services leader focused on improving the customer experience and driving business objectives. Passionate about fostering interdepartmental collaboration to ensure best-in-class customer outcomes from initial sales engagement and throughout the client lifecycle.

experiences.position: Senior Director, Professional Services Global Operations

experiences.description:
Responsible for the end-to-end operation of the global Professional Services Organization.  Leads key operational activities across the teams and acts as a key change leader in driving business and operational improvements.  Responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the Professional Services Organization. 

Focus areas include: annual planning, forecasting, reporting and analytics, P&L management, business process optimization, Delivery operations, resource management, as well as other KPIs necessary to manage the business.

experiences.position: Senior Director, Professional Services and Customer Care
experiences.description:
Led the professional services and customer care teams responsible for implementing and supporting a global customer base. Reported to the Chief Customer Officer. 

Hired, managed, and coached members of the professional services and customer are teams. Partnered with sales on prospect calls to provide technical solutioning with attention to complex procurement business processes. Collaborated cross-departmentally to develop processes and product or service offerings that support customers from initial contract signature through their journey on the platform. Conducted weekly account review meetings with the executive team.

Led the professional services team within the Customer Success department. Established and monitored key project metrics and KPIs including Time to First Value. Responsible for operationalizing the professional services department and developing standard onboarding best practices to create efficiency and scalability.
Achievements:
•	Revised onboarding methodology to drive efficiency in the onboarding process
           - Reduced average ‘time to live’ by 33%
           - Reduced average time to first value by 40%
•	Implemented collaborative project management tool to improve the customer experience and enable effective reporting on key metrics including employee utilization, project duration, and time to ‘go live.’ during onboarding.
•	Created capacity planning model to inform headcount decision-making across the entire Customer Success department including six distinct roles. 
•	Developed and implemented internal handoff processes to ensure comprehensive knowledge transfer between teams
•	Created template SOWs for each standard onboarding offering
•	Developed sales enablement documents to explain the onboarding process

Led sixteen-member professional service team responsible for managing an average of two hundred active projects. Following Wolters Kluwer’s acquisition of eOriginal, selected to report directly to the Global VP of Client Experience and Delivery, Compliance Solutions Division. 

Supported sales team through technical solutioning with attention to business and regulatory concerns. Participated in multi-business strategic planning aimed at improving customer adoption and driving usage. Contributed to business group’s monthly operating review.  Hired, managed, and coached professional services team of project managers, implementation consultants, implementation engineers and an instructional designer. Led monthly cross departmental meetings to review customer use cases and discuss potential product enhancements.

•	COVID led to hyper-growth for digital lending and eOriginal’s business. Led professional services team through this growth cycle which continues today. Developed and implemented Quick Start implementation programs, reducing ‘time to live’ by 75%, in response to a surge in demand.
•	Implemented processes to improve customer experience during standard implementations and reduce ‘time to live’ by up to 50%. 
•	Reduced backlog growth of new customer onboardings by 96%.
•	Professionalized the use of project management tool, Wrike, to enable effective reporting on key metrics including employee utilization, project duration, and time to ‘go live.’ 
•	Created capacity planning tool to inform headcount decision-making for five distinct roles within the professional services team.
•	Transformed the eVault request process by leveraging a unique Salesforce case type to document requirements and assign tasks for new vault provisioning requests, provide visibility into new vault status, and improve customer experience in preparation for securitizations.
•	Scaled department to enable 200% ARR growth. Grew team from seven to sixteen team members.

Established and monitored team-wide metrics for new customer SaaS implementations and statements of work. Improved process for existing client add-on requests to foster transparency and accountability across departments. Coordinated with product team ahead of new releases to ensure professional services readiness. Presented at company-wide Town Hall meeting to represent the professional services team.

Developed and led the Talent Management division enabling +300% growth in annual revenue. Led clients through discovery evaluations to identify gaps in their organization’s talent management processes. Created and installed systems for retaining, developing, and attracting employees with the skills, experience, and attitudes needed to grow our customers’ organizations. Established and managed vendor relationships for sourcing and evaluating candidates for roles within customers’ organizations. Demonstrated strong customer service and account management skills through consistent communication and a superior level of accountability with clients. 
•	Consulted and trained customers on processes for on-going employee evaluation, development, and topgrading.
•	Administered and interpreted behavioral and position-based assessments on behalf of clients.
•	Created both internal and client-facing dashboards and reports on employee utilization, capacity planning, and hiring efforts.
•	Participated in strategic planning and led the department's growth.
•	Established and managed to key metrics such as referral rate, customer satisfaction score, renewal rate, and monthly recurring revenue.

Exceeded individual annual revenue targets by +35% and achieved over $400k of new sales revenue annually as part of this dual responsibility. Skilled in questioning/qualifying prospects to identify needs and sell solutions around team building, management process, organizational development, sales training, and hiring/onboarding.

Conducted quarterly reviews for existing clients and evaluated overall status of the account. Facilitated quarterly goal setting and identified opportunities for expansion of scope of work with client.

Established new accounts, ranging from small agencies to large government contracting firms. Demonstrated clear communication skills by identifying the needs of a client and articulating the cultural, as well as technical, qualifications needed for roles to Abacus’ recruiters. Attended networking events and maintained consistent contact both with clients and recruiters to further build relationships and ensure that the proper candidates were submitted for review.

Taught students in grades 9-12, including American Studies, IB World History, AP Government, Anthropology, ESL, English I, and US History classes. Led a team of four dorm parents and oversaw nearly forty student residents.
